name: Alan D. Schnitzer

career.title: Partner; lead outside counsel to Travelers
Vice Chairman and Chief Legal Officer
Vice Chairman overseeing Financial, Professional & International Insurance and U.S. Field Management
Vice Chairman and CEO, Business and International Insurance

background_rationale: A Simpson Thacher & Bartlett partner who served as Travelers' lead outside counsel, then joined as Chief Legal Officer before moving into business leadership.

notable.summary: Travelers completed its acquisition of UK small-business insurance distributor Simply Business, announced in March 2017 for about $490 million.
Schnitzer was elected Chairman of the Board in addition to CEO.

Travelers agreed to sell its Canadian personal insurance business and most of its Canadian commercial business to Definity for about US$2.4 billion, planning about US$0.7 billion of additional share repurchases in 2026.
Schnitzer called the Canadian sale "a reflection of our steadfast commitment to disciplined capital allocation and long-term value creation."

personal_story.hook: Alan Schnitzer was Travelers' lead outside lawyer before joining the insurer in 2007; eight years later he became its CEO.
personal_story.summary: Schnitzer, born in 1965, studied at the University of Pennsylvania and earned his law degree at Columbia Law School. As a partner at Simpson Thacher & Bartlett he served as Travelers' lead outside counsel, including on its 2004 merger with The St. Paul Companies. In 2007 he moved in-house as Vice Chairman and Chief Legal Officer, then shifted to running insurance businesses in 2014 before succeeding Jay Fishman as CEO in December 2015.
